newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Continental head eyes Aerolineas Argentinas - report.
newsitem.headline: Continental head eyes Aerolineas Argentinas - report.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc is considering buying a stake in Argentine flag carrier Aerolineas Argentinas, Continental president Greg Brenneman said in Thursday's La Nacion newspaper.
"Our principal objective is to fly to Argentina and we would like to do it in partnership with Aerolineas Argentinas," Brenneman told La Nacion during a recent visit to Buenos Aires.

"This could mean an alliance, which does not require investment, an acquisition by a group of investors of which Continental would be a partner or would maybe contribute some money, or Continental investing directly," he said, "To know what to do we need more information."
But Brenneman stressed that Continental had yet to form an opinion on the value of the company.
"It is still very early to talk about offers," he said.
Local press have reported that Aerolineas has also been considering an alliance with American Airlines, but Brenneman said that Continental had more to offer.

"Aerolineas has two options. The first is to ally itself with American Airlines and get more of the same. They would take the most profitable passengers, the business passengers who pay three times as much for the ticket, and leave (Aerolineas) with the rest, which is what is happening in Central America.

"Or it can ally itself with Continental as an equal partner. We would give it more traffic in Miami, and we would work in Newark and Houston," he said, "Together we can compete in this very competitive market."

The largest shareholder in Aerolineas, with a 63 percent stake, is Andes Holding, which is in turn owned by Merrill Lynch, Bankers Trust and the Spanish government's holding company Teneo. The Spanish government also owns more shares through its flag carrier Iberia, which has 10 percent of Aerolineas.
Iberia said in late January it has not received any offers for its interest in the Argentine airline and was undecided about the future of its stake.
Apart from Continental's expression of interest, Brazil's VASP has said that it was interested in buying into Aerolineas.
